title: Saved report columns reset once and an old Product Type link shows all types
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Before the release was installed, you changed the columns and the sort of Sales By Representative and bookmarked a link that narrowed it by Product Type.
  • Starting screen: the release is installed and you open Reports > Sales By Representative in the same browser, desktop width at least 1024 px.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the columns and the sort.
  2. Change a column and the sort, leave the report and open it again.
  3. Open the link bookmarked before the release.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the columns and the sort are back to the defaults, and the Sales Type column is off.
  • Step 2: your new choices are kept; the reset happened only once.
  • Step 3: the report opens with every Sales Type selected ("Sales Type: All").

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 10 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative), story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • Release day: “Each user's saved column choices and sort on Sales By Representative reset once to the defaults. The "Sales Rep Assignments" export is renamed "Sales Representative Assignments" (S4-R23). A saved link that narrowed Sales By Representative by Product Type opens with every Sales Type selected.”
